scenes.en: Your desk setup may be the reason.
scenes.say: Eyes tired and heavy by four p.m.? Your desk setup may be the reason.

scenes.en: A close screen makes the focusing muscles inside your eye work hard all day.
scenes.ta: அருகில் பார்க்கும்போது கண் தசைகள் அதிகம் உழைக்கும்
scenes.say: When a screen is too close, the focusing muscles inside your eye work hard all day, like holding a heavy bag without a break.

scenes.en: Screen an arm's length away. Top of screen at or just below eye level.
scenes.ta: திரை ஒரு கை நீளம் தூரத்தில் இருக்கட்டும்
scenes.say: Step one: keep the screen about an arm's length away. The top of the screen should be at, or just below, eye level, so you look slightly down.

scenes.en: Window to the side, not behind the screen. Room about as bright as the screen.
scenes.say: Step two: stop the glare. Keep the window to the side, not behind the screen. And keep the room about as bright as your screen.

scenes.en: We blink much less while looking at screens.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show we blink much less while looking at a screen. That's why eyes feel dry and gritty.

scenes.en: Every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
scenes.ta: 20 நிமிடத்திற்கு ஒருமுறை, 20 அடி தூரம், 20 வினாடி பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Step three: every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away, for twenty seconds. And blink fully.

scenes.en: Headaches or blur at work? You may need glasses for screen distance.
scenes.ta: தலைவலி, மங்கல் இருந்தால் கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள்
scenes.say: Still getting headaches, or blurry vision at work? You may need glasses made for screen distance. Book an eye test.
